description: Observed results of the incident-shaped Patterns RS-48 to RS-53, 2026-11-22, with `node dist/runner.js --incident --cli none` (main at be337d3). incident-probe-predictions.json was committed before the Patterns existed and is not edited.

reasons: Trust principals must contain literal strings
results.note: Differs from the prediction. CDK writes AccountPrincipal as Fn::Join with Ref AWS::Partition, which the extractor cannot read in a trust policy, so the template is rejected (fail closed) instead of accepted. The chain itself is still not modeled: with a literal account ARN the template would be accepted.
